stem.en: A scribe must share 60 sacks of barley equally among some families, with no sack left over. Which number of families will NOT work?

feedback.en: This works: 60 shared by 5 gives 12 sacks each, with none left over.
This works: 60 shared by 12 gives 5 sacks each, with none left over.
This works: 60 shared by 15 gives 4 sacks each, with none left over.

explanation.en: 7 times 8 is 56, so 7 families get 8 sacks each and 4 sacks are left over. 5, 12 and 15 all divide 60 exactly.

hints.en: Try each number: does it go into 60 exactly?
